deals.title: Refurb Apple AirPods Max USB-C Wireless Over-Ear Headphones for $300 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: With promo code "SAVE20TECH", these refurbished Apple AirPods Max headphones drop to $300 at eBay, down from $375, and the best price we've seen. They are $129 less than Best Buy charges for them in new condition. The USB-C version has the same hardware as the 2020 original., and it adds wired lossless audio over a USB-C to USB-C cable. Noise cancellation is unchanged from the original, and wired use with non-USB-C devices needs a separate USB-C to 3.5mm cable. A one-year Allstate warranty is provided with purchase. Coupon ends November 8.
